description: Search HERB 2.0 for a herb, ingredient, gene target or disease by Chinese name, pinyin, English name, Latin name, gene alias or HERB id — e.g. "板蓝根", "banlangen", "Dyers Woad" and "BAN LAN GEN" all resolve the same herb record. Returns matching ids to pass to herb_detail. Does not itself carry evidence tiers (it is a name lookup, not a relationship).

category.description: Which table to search. Defaults to "herb".

keyword.description: Search term: Chinese characters, pinyin, English/Latin name, gene name/alias, disease name, or a HERB id (e.g. HERB004520, HBIN016960).

name: herb_search
title: Herb Search
